workload.headline: rearrange_e2e
workload.note: EPLB rebalance index logic on CPU, Qwen3-Next-80B -dp 8 geometry (8 ranks x 68 local = 544 physical experts, 48 MoE layers) as in the author's server. rearrange_e2e = the arm's real move_to_buffer + move_from_buffer for every layer and every rank with P2P transport stubbed and tiny weights (index mapping only). Three primitives kept as secondary metrics. All units ms (bench.py times in ms).
